name: Luminara Suite
tagline: Projects, context, and reports for one Luminara account.
description: Luminara Suite lets an AI agent use the projects, context, and reports on a signed-in account. Free and Starter have a daily call cap. Growth and Agency do not. Paid research needs Agency or the caller's own DataForSEO login.

scopes.name: mcp:free
scopes.description: Projects, context, and reports. This is the scope a hosted OAuth client receives after Allow.

scopes.name: mcp:research
scopes.description: Hosted paid research. Granted when an Agency plan authorizes outside the hosted connector screen. A hosted client can still pass its own DataForSEO login in x-provider-key.

redirectUris.hostedHttps: Any https URI with no userinfo and no fragment. The client must register it first. Authorize redirects only to a URI on that client's record.
redirectUris.loopback: http or https on localhost, 127.0.0.1, or ::1. The port may differ from the registered URI. The path and query must match.
rejected: https with a username, password, or fragment

examplePrompts.prompt: Who is this connection, and how many MCP calls are left today?
List the projects on this account.
Read the project context for this project id before any research.
List report summaries for that project. Do not fetch HTML.
Save this report for the project and give me the link.
